works.version: Clément et al., Shape coexistence in neutron-deficient krypton isotopes; HAL in2p3-00141102 author manuscript; journal DOI 10.1103/PhysRevC.75.054313
scope: PDF 1 repository cover and article identity; PDF 2–22 includes experiment, differential gamma yields, fit and constraints, matrix elements, shape comparisons and references.

PDF 15 Table X: 74Kr downward B(E2;2_1+ -> 0_1+)=0.122(2) e^2 b^2 and B(E2;0_2+ -> 2_1+)=0.47(5) e^2 b^2. Fit includes prior spectroscopic constraints and keeps measured yields separate from model shape interpretation.
works.gap: Prior lifetime and branching inputs used in the Coulomb-excitation fit must be counted with their dependencies.
works.lineage: Primary spectroscopy study; each experimental quantity and prior constraint belongs to its stated acquisition.

works.version: Starosta et al., Shape and structure of N=Z 64Ge; arXiv:nucl-ex/0703021v1, journal DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.99.042503

PDF 3 lifetime text and Table I: tau(2_1+)=3.3(5) ps and tau(2_2+)=8(+4,-2) ps; downward strengths respectively 410(60) and 620(210) e^2 fm^4 for the 2_1+->0_1+ and 2_2+->2_1+ branches.
works.gap: Table I has experimental blanks in the static moments and several in-band/out-of-band rows; GXPF1A values do not fill those blanks.

works.version: Ann-Cecilie Larsen, The Oslo method for nuclear-model ingredients: Recent results and applications, PND2-3 public talk
scope: PDF 1–14 framework and setups; 15–31 methodological and regional cases; 32–40 preliminary iodine and other indirect-rate cases; 41–44 summary and backup transition; 45–61 method and response examples. Text plus visual checks of key spectra, charts and equations.

PDF 32 gives initial E_x–E_gamma sorting and PDF 33 shows explicitly preliminary gamma-strength plots. PDF 46 first-generation subtraction; PDF 48 gives 2052 pixels and 184 free parameters for the Fe56 case; PDF 49–54 covers factorization and normalization.
works.gap: Presentation of work in progress and referenced measurements. Iodine pending strength plots share the OCL data; no thesis, covariance, final numbers, or independent experiment established.
works.lineage: Reused comparisons and preliminary observations are separated from independent primary data.
